ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon New Firewall Rule Added In Windows Firewall Exception List
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a rule has been added to the Windows Firewall exception list Note: Unmapped fields: Action, ApplicationPath, ModifyingApplication

sequences.query: (event_id = 2004 OR event_id = 2071 OR event_id = 2097) AND  NOT (Action = 2 OR (ApplicationPath = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR ApplicationPath = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR ApplicationPath = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR ApplicationPath = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR ApplicationPath = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\")) OR (ApplicationPath = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Tmp\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR ApplicationPath = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR ApplicationPath = "None") AND  NOT ((ModifyingApplication = RGX("^C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Platform\\\\") AND ModifyingApplication = RGX("\\\\MsMpEng\\\.exe$")) OR ((ModifyingApplication = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost\.exe" OR ModifyingApplication = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\dllhost\.exe") AND ApplicationPath = ""))
